faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ANIIDCO Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Senior Consultant (Urban Planning /Design/ Mobility Expert - Part Time) post is 28th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Urban Planning /Design to be eligible for the Senior Consultant position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Consultant post is 62 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Consultant role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Consultant (Urban Planning /Design/ Mobility Expert - Part Time) post ranges from Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 45,000 per day.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the ANIIDCO Senior Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and send it via post to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Consultant position?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Consultant post is scheduled for 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of ANIIDCO?
faq.answer: The official website of Andaman and Nicobar Islands Integrated Development Corporation (ANIIDCO) is https://aniidco.and.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Senior Consultant (Urban Planning /Design/ Mobility Expert - Part Time) post is Contractual.
